rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip code mapped to a single user ID, reviewed orders via read-only tools, identified the correct bicycle order, and confirmed the exact action (returning only the bicycle and refunding to the specified card) before performing the write. They then executed the return via the proper tool and provided appropriate follow-up information. A minor concern is that the agent stated the refund would go to the “original payment method (Mastercard ending 8484)” without clearly confirming the order’s payment history in the transcript, but they did confirm that refund destination with the user prior to submitting, and there is no tool output contradicting it. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
